expectations.text: The response mentions at least one fact found in notes/worklog.md (VP review next Thursday, trial cut from 14 to 7 days, or onboarding complaints)
expectations.evidence: “工作日志里 8 月中试用期 14 天→7 天” and “老板要下周四给 VP 看” both repeat worklog facts.

expectations.text: Found facts are presented for the user to confirm rather than asked as open questions
expectations.evidence: Worklog facts are stated as established: “9 月 8 日起"太难上手"投诉变多”. The confirmation request concerns the proposed plan, not the found facts.

expectations.text: The response still asks the user something only they can answer, such as the purpose or what done looks like
expectations.evidence: “`{{plan}}` 我写了草案（试用回滚/上手专项/流失预警/收入预期持平），需要你确认或替换。” This requests the user's decision on the proposed plan.
